title: Adversarial review without checklist theater
summary: Bounded adversarial review of a film: pick a named pass, review the brief then the exact final encode, record untested/observed/blocked/not-applicable with hashed evidence, say what was not checked.
description: This is the owner's authoritative adversarial review bank: the 1,024 questions of Appendix E of the Animation and Video Production Master Guide (10 Oct 2026), transcribed with the owner's exact text, ids, filters and pass membership. Another builder in this catalogue (harness_kit) independently wrote a different 1,024-question bank; it is not this set and does not override it.

side_effects: hashes, probes and decodes the artifact under review

evidence_notes: Method taken from the guide's section. The guide records a 17-record focused film application (11 observed passes, 4 untested potential improvements, 2 audio blockers), 39 passing validator regression tests and 3 contact-sheet lineages reproduced from exact MP4s; it says these do not establish that whole films were watched continuously or listened to independently.
